This is a **stylized low-poly humanoid**, not a photorealistic sports scan, nor an
officially licensed player or jersey. Avoid any implication of real clubs or teams.
Existing Cesium rig remains the offline fallback.

Available source animation clips: clapping, death/fall, idle, jump, punch,
run, running jump, sitting, standing, sword slash, walk. v22 currently uses
run, walk, idle and fall as generic athletic transitions; these are **not**
motion-captured rugby passes or tackles. No sport rules or saved games changed.
